chain_words.nuance: to suggest wrongdoing without stating it openly
to make previously private information known
to make something hidden visible or known
to find out and bring to light something concealed
to reveal wrongdoing so that it is publicly condemned

explanation: These words all describe bringing hidden facts to light, from a faint hint of wrongdoing to a full public exposure.

usage_notes.difference: 'Reveal' means making something hidden known; 'expose' means revealing wrongdoing so that it is publicly condemned.
